teen_points.text: Learner-permit driving is limited to 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
teen_points.quote: A DC DMV learner permit entitles you to drive between the hours of 6:00 am and 9:00 pm.

teen_points.text: GRAD covers ages 16 through 21, from learner permit to provisional license to a full license.
teen_points.quote: are between 16 and 21 years old

teen_points.text: A provisional license follows the permit phase and a road skills test.
teen_points.quote: Intermediate phase, in which you earn a provisional license after you complete the permit phase and pass the road skills test.

teen_points.text: A full license with conditions can be requested online at age 17 after six months on a provisional license.
teen_points.quote: You must be at least 17 years old.

out_of_state_permit: A valid learner permit from another state or jurisdiction does not transfer by itself. The applicant takes the DC knowledge test at a service center.
out_of_state_permit_quote: If you have a valid learner permit from another state or jurisdiction you will need to visit a DC DMV service center and take the knowledge test to begin the process of obtaining a DC DMV learner permit.
curfew: A learner permit allows driving from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. A provisional license has later evening hours that change by season and by day of the week. Full-license drivers have no driving-hour restriction once they turn 18.
curfew_quote: A DC DMV learner permit entitles you to drive between the hours of 6:00 am and 9:00 pm.
passengers: The GRAD page says there are no passenger restrictions for full-license drivers once they turn 18.
passengers_quote: There are no driving hours or passenger restrictions for full license drivers once you turn 18 years old.

gaps: The provisional-license page that opened explains online conversion to a full license at 17. It does not print a separate minimum age for first receiving the provisional license, so license_age is empty.
The DMV fees book page that opened did not print learner-permit dollar amounts in the text that was retrieved. The $47 figure is the online conversion fee on the provisional-license page.
Supervised daytime practice hours for the learner stage were not stated as a number on the pages that opened. Ten night hours are required before the online full-license conversion.
The Georgetown service center closure notice on these pages is operational and was not treated as a licensing rule.
